title: Triple Check EA - 3 Indicators Confirmation Strategy
entry_long: EMA 9 > EMA 200 AND EMA 9 crosses above EMA 26 AND bullish engulfing (body > ID2) AND RSI below 30 (oversold) AND stochastic crosses above 30
entry_short: EMA 9 < EMA 200 AND EMA 9 crosses below EMA 26 AND bearish engulfing AND RSI above 70 (overbought) AND stochastic crosses below 70
exit: No explicit SL/TP mentioned; trailing stop mode discussed
escalation_cap: capped at 2 lots (multiply by 2 on loss, return to 0.1 on win)
buildon_idea: Capped martingale at 2x only; tested with 3-indicator confirmation. Flat-lot test first (0.1L fixed) to baseline; try linear/log scaling if needed. Monitor stochastic period tuning per timeframe (7 for 1-30min TFs).
novelty_note: High-indicator-count entry filter (3+ signals); overbought/oversold zones + pattern confirmation; martingale kept minimal (2x max)

title: RSI-Based Grid EA with Special Doji Pattern (Example 86)
entry_long: RSI crosses above 30 (oversold) AND grid distance spacing (15 pips minimum) confirmed AND special doji pattern (wick >> body) forms
entry_short: RSI crosses below 70 (overbought) AND grid distance spacing confirmed AND bearish doji reversal
exit: Take profit at close_1=10pips (single trade) or close_2=5pips (multiple stacked trades); managed via check_profit block
escalation_cap: grid spacing 15 pips between orders; flat-lot 0.1L per order
buildon_idea: Grid with RSI oversold/overbought zones; doji as reversal confirmation to reduce false signals. Test flat-lot baseline first. Can upgrade to log-scaled grid (0.1->0.1->0.15->0.2) if spacing consistent.
novelty_note: RSI + doji reversal pattern fusion; grid spacing as mechanical filter; minimal SL reliance

title: EMA Crossover with Auto Lot or Martingale
entry_long: EMA 10 crosses above EMA 50 (on candle ID 1)
entry_short: EMA 10 crosses below EMA 50 (on candle ID 1)
escalation_cap: Auto-lot mode: scale with balance (10k->0.1L, 20k->0.2L). Martingale mode: starts 0.1L, doubles on loss, resets to 0.1L on win
buildon_idea: Switchable lot law (auto-lot vs martingale); simple 2-EMA system. Flat-lot test first. If martingale selected, cap steps (max 4-5 doublings before SL). Test on 5min+ timeframes; tune EMA periods per TF.
novelty_note: Dual-mode EA (auto-lot vs capped martingale); user selects in Expert Property; clean entry/exit logic

title: EMA Crossover with Auto Lot or Martingale (English)
entry_long: EMA 10 crosses above EMA 50; EMA 10 above EMA 200 (trend align)
entry_short: EMA 10 crosses below EMA 50; EMA 10 below EMA 200 (trend align)
escalation_cap: Auto-lot: 0.1L per 100k balance. Martingale: 0.1L start, 2x on loss, 1x on win
buildon_idea: Same as EX001 (JQ90QIo7wBM); English-language version. Test auto-lot mode first (safest). If using martingale, cap max steps and use SL.
novelty_note: Educational example in English; 2-EMA + 200-period trend filter; switchable lot law

title: Auto Trend Line with Martingale (EX002)
entry_long: Highest price over last 50 candles > highest price over last 15 candles (creates uptrend line) AND candle close (ID 1) breaks above trendline (Buy) AND stochastic < 20 (oversold condition)
entry_short: Lowest price over 50 candles < lowest over 15 candles (downtrend line) AND candle close (ID 1) breaks below trendline AND stochastic > 80 (overbought)
escalation_cap: Initial lot 0.1L, multiply 2x on loss, reset to 0.1L on win
buildon_idea: Auto-drawn trend lines; stochastic filter for oversold/overbought zones. Trend lines dynamically updated each bar. Can add position cap (max 3-4 steps) to avoid ruin. Test on trending markets (EU, GU H1-4H).
novelty_note: Dynamic trend line construction (moving window); stochastic confirmation; martingale with explicit SL/TP

title: Bollinger Band Grid with Auto Lot Scaling (EX003)
entry_long: Candle ID 1 low < BB lower band AND candle ID 2 low < BB lower band AND candle has min body 5 pips
entry_short: Candle ID 1 high > BB upper band AND candle ID 2 high > BB upper band AND candle has min body 5 pips
exit: When combined profit (long+short all active) > close_1 (10 pips) for 1 trade; close_2 (5 pips) for multiple stacked trades
escalation_cap: Grid distance 50 pips; lot scales by distance: if gap >= 50 pips then 0.1L * 2 = 0.2L; if gap < 50 pips then 0.1L (flat)
buildon_idea: Grid with BB bands; auto-scale lot based on distance from last order. Currently uncapped - add position limit (max 5-6 orders). Test flat-lot mode first (0.1L all). If scaling active, enforce 50-pip minimum spacing and cap total positions.
novelty_note: Dual take-profit logic (close_1 single, close_2 stacked); distance-based auto-lot for grid; BB oversold/overbought zones

title: Equity Drawdown Controlling Strategy with EMA (EX004)
entry_long: EMA 12 crosses above EMA 20 (candle ID 2) AND EMA 12 > EMA 20 (candle ID 0) AND distance between EMA 12 and EMA 20 > 3 pips
entry_short: EMA 12 crosses below EMA 20 (candle ID 2) AND EMA 12 < EMA 20 (candle ID 0) AND distance >= 3 pips
exit: When combined profit (all open trades) > close_Money (30 USD/pips); or when equity drops below threshold (equity - 5% drawdown cap)
escalation_cap: Initial 0.1L, double on loss (0.1->0.2->0.4...), reset on win. If equity < (start_equity - 5%) then STOP opening new trades; revert to flat 0.1L only
buildon_idea: Martingale gated by equity threshold (stop escalation if DD > 5%). Risk-managed escalation. Can tighten DD cap (3-4%) for lower-balance accounts. Flat-lot baseline first, then tune DD% threshold per account.
novelty_note: Equity drawdown brake on martingale; prevents ruin-level escalation; profit target split (single vs stacked)

title: Candlestick Pattern Guide - 6-Candle Reversal Pattern (EX005)
entry_long: Candles ID 1,2,3 = uptrend (blue) + ID 4,5,6 = downtrend (red) forming reversal -> BUY at ID 0 open (Mean-reversion entry)
entry_short: Candles ID 1,2,3 = downtrend (red) + ID 4,5,6 = uptrend (blue) forming reversal -> SELL at ID 0 open
buildon_idea: 6-candle reversal pattern (no SL stated); mean-reversion at pattern completion. Add SL (20-30 pips) for safety. Consider pattern strength filter (body size > 5 pips minimum for all 6 candles). Grid to average down on counter-moves (0.1L per level).
novelty_note: Multi-candle pattern recognition (6-bar reversal); simple TP-only exit; no SL

title: Spinning Top Candlestick Pattern (EX006)
entry_long: Candle ID 1 = spinning top doji (wick size >> body, body < 4 pips) + ID 2,3 = uptrend (blue, body > 4 pips) -> BUY at ID 0 open
entry_short: Candle ID 1 = spinning top doji + ID 2,3 = downtrend (red, body > 4 pips) -> SELL at ID 0 open
escalation_cap: Initial 0.1L, multiply 2x on loss, reset to 0.1L on win
buildon_idea: Spinning top + trend confirmation (2 candles); martingale escalation. Cap steps (max 3-4 doubles before SL hit). Sufficient capital required for 0.1->0.2->0.4->0.8L sequence. Test with higher initial capital (10k+) to avoid ruin.
novelty_note: Spinning top (indecision candle) as entry trigger + multi-candle confirmation; martingale with explicit SL/TP; doji reversal pattern
